items.title: WPI inflation, oil, FII trading activity may guide stock markets this week
items.description: Investors will track October WPI inflation, trade data, foreign investor activity and crude oil prices, while US retail sales, Nvidia's earnings and Fed minutes are expected to shape global sentiment

items.title: Sebi plans AI guardrails for capital markets, focus on investor protection
items.description: Sebi floated a consultation paper proposing guiding principles for responsible usage of Artificial Intelligence (AI)/ Machine Learning (ML) applications/models in securities markets

items.title: FPIs pump ₹84,290 crore into equities in first fortnight of November
items.description: The latest inflows follow net withdrawals of ₹34,843 crore in October and ₹35,861 crore in September, according to data from the depositories
